about: SignWithLabel (RFC 9420 5.1.2) as hoptell's lib/mls/identity.js encodes it: signContent = varint(len) || "MLS 1.0 " + label || varint(len) || content; Ed25519 over those bytes. publicKey: raw 32 bytes of a fixed test key (seed SHA-256("hoptell-sign-with-label-vectors-v1")). The same file is in hoptell (test/vectors) and the bake-off (spike/mls-bakeoff/vectors).
